# Pandamonium v1.0.52

This release ships the full built-in tool catalog for the agent, the extension capability and scan contracts, and a small sidebar polish pass.

Agent turns now mount every enabled built-in tool, `manage_settings list_tools` reports the real catalog, and `load_tools` mounts any tool on demand for the remainder of a request. In the sidebar, bucket headers are flush left again at rest — the drag handle reveals itself only on hover and slides the label aside instead of permanently reserving a column — and the Projects section no longer prints instruction text under its header when it is empty.

## MAD-905 — Agent: mount the full built-in tool catalog

### Problem

The Built-in Tools panel catalogs 80 tools, but API turns mounted only the RAG-selected subset (a live session showed 23 of 80) and `manage_settings list_tools` returned a hardcoded summary instead of the catalog. The agent could not invoke two-thirds of its own tools and often concluded a tool was missing.

### Implementation

API-host engines mount every enabled built-in schema each round; per-turn intent clamps stay authoritative and the measured tool-catalog budget (`cap_tool_schemas`) is the only trim. `manage_settings action=list_tools` returns the real catalog with id, category, description, and enabled state. `generate_image` and `manage_research` gained native schemas and `tail_serve_output` a toggle, closing the catalog/callable parity drift.

### Product value and UI visibility

No UI change. Every tool the Built-in Tools panel lists as enabled is now actually callable on API engines, and "how many tools do you have?" is answered from live state.

### Verification

`tests/test_agent_tool_catalog_uncap.py` covers full API mounting, disabled-tool respect, intent-clamp preservation, the real catalog listing, and schema/toggle parity; 212 + 244 focused regression tests pass alongside workspace confine, context manifest, release self-knowledge, and network routing checks.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

No new dependency or configuration. Small-context models remain bounded by the measured tool-catalog budget; retrieved tools rank first when the cap trims.

### References

- [Linear MAD-905](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-905/agent-uncap-the-built-in-tool-catalog-full-native-tool-reach-for-api)
- [Catalog PR](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/pull/105)

## MAD-907 — Agent: mount catalog tools on demand for local/text engines

### Problem

Local/text engines receive only the RAG-selected fenced-block prompt, so most of the catalog was unreachable even after the API fix, and a budget-capped turn had no way to recover a dropped tool.

### Implementation

`manage_settings action=load_tools` mounts any enabled built-in for the remainder of the request and returns its exact fenced-block usage so a local model can format the call immediately. The agent loop unions a result's `mounted_tools` into its selection and ranks mounted names ahead of the budget cap; the discovery gateway (`manage_settings`) stays available on every turn, with network-inspection turns keeping it out through the existing allowlist clamp. Disabled and unknown ids are reported without failing the turn.

### Product value and UI visibility

No UI change. A local model, or any capped turn, can list the live catalog and pull exactly the tool it needs into reach instead of claiming the capability does not exist.

### Verification

`tests/test_tool_catalog_mount.py` covers mount validation, unknown/disabled reporting, prompt-section delivery, and the budget-cap recovery round-trip; 441 focused regression tests pass including `tests/test_agent_relevant_tools_isolation.py`.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

No new dependency or configuration. Mounts last for the current request only and never override per-turn intent clamps.

### References

- [Linear MAD-907](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-907/mad-905-agent-localtext-engine-on-demand-tool-catalog-mount-part-22)
- [Mount PR](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/pull/119)

## MAD-908 — UI: keep bucket headers flush and drop the Projects empty-state copy

### Problem

The bucket drag handle introduced with section reordering occupied layout space even while invisible. Every sidebar section icon and label was pushed right by the reserved handle column, which read as a misalignment against the rest of the sidebar. Separately, an empty Projects section rendered an instruction sentence under the header that cluttered the list.

### Implementation

The handle is now absolutely positioned inside the section header, contributes no layout width, and is pointer-transparent at rest so it cannot intercept a click meant for the section title. Hovering or keyboard-focusing a header reveals the handle and transitions the label right by the handle width; leaving restores it. Rearrange mode keeps the shifted layout so the handle never overlaps the label. The Projects empty-state element and its render/error copy were removed; an empty section shows only its header and the add control.

### Product value and UI visibility

Sidebar icons and labels line up exactly as they did before reordering was added. The affordance is discoverable on hover without permanently costing alignment, and the Projects list is quiet when empty.

### Verification

`tests/test_bucket_header_flush.py` guards the overlay positioning, the hover slide, the pointer-events behavior, and the removed empty-state markup. The browser check in `tests/browser/mad-899-ui-batch.spec.js` measures the label position at rest versus on hover, asserts the handle opacity transition, and asserts no `#projects-empty` element exists.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

Frontend-only CSS/markup/JS change with no data, schema, or API impact. Touch layouts already hid the handle and are unchanged. No new dependency.

### References

- [Linear MAD-908](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-908/ui-keep-bucket-headers-flush-and-drop-the-projects-empty-state-copy)
- [Fix PR](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/pull/117)

## MAD-911 — Extensions: capability inventory, lazy-mount, and scan contracts

### Problem

Extension intake needed versioned contracts before any registry, adapter, route, or UI work could safely begin: how installed capabilities are inventoried without implying they are live, how an agent lazily mounts a named capability for one turn without a schema flood, and how a static scan produces bounded, redacted evidence without executing repository code.

### Implementation

Adds `specs/extension-capability-inventory-contract.md` plus strict JSON schemas for the inventory and scan artifacts, and pure validator/build helpers in `src/extension_capability_inventory.py`. Inventory entries are revision-bound to the source revision and manifest digest, stay separate from live `effective_capabilities` (disable clears effective but preserves inventory), and fail closed on staleness or tampering. The lazy-mount contract defines per-turn schema injection, execution allowlisting, and how mounts interact with `cap_tool_schemas`, the tool-catalog budget, and `_relevant_tools` pruning. The scan contract defines the stage enum, artifact shape, bounds, mandatory evidence redaction, and the static-only no-execution boundary.

### Product value and UI visibility

No UI change. Establishes the contracts the extension intake milestones implement, including the stage and progress events a future scan UI will render.

### Verification

`tests/test_extension_capability_inventory_contract.py` validates the schemas, revision and digest binding, fail-closed staleness and tamper rules, sanitized advisory projection, per-turn mount resolution, and scan bounds and redaction; the existing suite is unchanged and green.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

Contract-only: no registry, adapter, route, or runtime behavior change; no new dependency. The MCP probe remains the single explicit runtime verification.

### References

- [Linear MAD-911](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-911/extensions-define-the-capability-inventory-lazy-mount-and-scan)
- [Contracts PR](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/pull/122)
